family.description: CSS font-family; a monospace font keeps glyphs on the grid.

lineHeight.description: Row height as a multiple of the font size.

indent.description: Columns per tree level; the elbow `└─> ` takes 4.

laneGap.description: Minimum column distance between lanes sharing rows.

parentRule.description: Tree parent: DFS discoverer, or the caller closest above that passes the stem check.

mode.description: glyph: box-drawing characters; vector: SVG paths from the same grid.

arrow.description: Order callers: `└─>` and `<─┘` when true, `└──` and `──┘` when false. Order callees never draws arrowheads.

cross.description: Glyph where a lane crosses a horizontal of another net without joining.

curve.description: Vector mode: orthogonal lines from the grid, rounded corners, sigmoid S-curves from caller to callee, or a B-spline through the route bends. Glyph mode always draws UTF box drawing.

strip.description: Module prefixes removed from labels, e.g. "gutai.".

colors.description: CSS colors; keys fg, bg, edge, highlight, seed, frame, namespace, external, selected.

enabled.description: Namespace boxes for packages and folders; labels relative to their box.

modules.description: Also box each module or file.

root.description: Draw the outermost box when every node lies in it.

fill.description: Background color per box, hue from the box name.

line.description: Frame line: dashed (default) and dotted frames read apart from solid call lines.

cross.description: Router cost per crossing of another call.

border.description: Router cost per box border crossed.

channel.description: Base width of the routing channel between sibling boxes.
